In 2000, the production of Monopoly was what percentage of the production of Ludo?
solution:
**Given:**

Production of Monopoly in 2000 = 90

Production of Ludo in 2000 = 200

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part / Whole) × 100

**Calculations:**

Percentage = (90 / 200) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 0.45 × 100

⇒ Percentage = 45%

**∴ The production of Monopoly in 2000 was 45% of the production of Ludo.**
